plain_english_revision: The amendment adds two new criminal offenses to the bill: performing a vasectomy becomes a Class A felony, and attempting to perform one becomes a Class C felony.
candidate_position_supported: The amendment advances a policy position that criminalizes male sterilization procedures (vasectomies) by defining them as felonies under Alabama law.
evidence_quotes: (c) A man who has a vasectomy shall be guilty of a Class A felony.
(d) A man who attempts to have a vasectomy shall be guilty of a Class C felony.
